_doc: Contextual explanations (story 11.5). Each hint opens once per player, the first time its event fires. `event` is a game event; `match` keeps only payloads whose fields equal the given values (a list means any of them; `$: true` matches the bare `true` of chase:seen); `who: event` addresses the player named in the payload, `all` every player. Texts are i18n keys hint.<id>.title / hint.<id>.body, and the body may use {move} {sprint} {jump} {interact} {map} {pause} {defend} {kiai} {manual} {toolPrev} {toolNext} {toolUse} for the player's real controls. `cooldownSeconds` keeps two hints from following each other at once.
